import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_41/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_41/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)  # Source2_41_0: ['Mouse ID', 'Drug']
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)  # Source2_41_1: ['Mouse ID', 'Timepoint', 'Tumor Volume (mm3)', 'Metastatic Sites']

# Operation 1: JOIN on "Mouse ID"
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="Mouse ID", how="inner")

# Operation 2: group_by [Source2_41_0.Drug, Source2_41_1.Timepoint], aggregations = avg(Source2_41_1.Metastatic Sites)
# Group by 'Drug' and 'Timepoint', aggregate mean of 'Metastatic Sites'
df_grouped = (
    df_joined.groupby(['Drug', 'Timepoint'], as_index=False)
    .agg({'Metastatic Sites': 'mean'})
)

# Ensure the target schema types:
# 'Drug': string, 'Timepoint': integer, 'Metastatic Sites': float
df_grouped['Drug'] = df_grouped['Drug'].astype(str)
df_grouped['Timepoint'] = df_grouped['Timepoint'].astype(int)
df_grouped['Metastatic Sites'] = df_grouped['Metastatic Sites'].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_41/target_multisource.csv"
df_grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_41/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_41/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on Mouse ID
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="Mouse ID", how="inner")

# Group by Drug and Timepoint, aggregate average of Metastatic Sites
result = joined.groupby(["Drug", "Timepoint"], as_index=False).agg({"Metastatic Sites": "mean"})

# Ensure column order and types match target schema
result = result[["Drug", "Timepoint", "Metastatic Sites"]]
result["Drug"] = result["Drug"].astype(str)
result["Timepoint"] = result["Timepoint"].astype(int)
result["Metastatic Sites"] = result["Metastatic Sites"].astype(float)

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_41/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
